endorsements.name: Timothy Wright
endorsements.label: Reverse Engineering Hardware via the HRES
endorsements.description: The Hardware Reverse Engineering Stanardard or HRES has been designed to provide security engineers with a framework to reverse engineer hardware and make the process repeatable and measurable. The process follows the same high level process structure as the PTES but focuses on testing and reversing embedded systems and firmware. My presentation will present the process and all online documentation to the security community for feedback and acceptance. Tim has over 20 years in information security with a focus on performing red team engagements. He is currently the red team lead for a major power company and works on his own time to learn more about security. @redteam_hacker
